info.name: Waypoint Backend API
info.description: Run folders in order. Health checks need only the backend and PostgreSQL. Authentication requests cover Google login, Microsoft OAuth with PKCE, Waypoint session exchange/refresh, replay protection and bearer-token enforcement. Successful provider login stores the shared Waypoint jwt and userId. Microsoft consent uses the real Chrome extension web-auth redirect. Checkout requests require Lemon Squeezy test-mode credentials. Webhook requests generate X-Signature automatically from webhookSecret.

request.description: Optional explicit account-link test. Starts Microsoft OAuth while authenticated so the Microsoft identity is linked to the current Waypoint user instead of being matched by email. Open microsoftAuthorizationUrl through the extension web-auth flow and complete the callback normally.
Explicitly removes the Microsoft provider credential/link for the authenticated Waypoint user. This is intentionally separate from logout.

Revokes the current Waypoint JWT and all Waypoint refresh sessions while preserving any linked Microsoft identity. To verify link persistence, sign in with the same Microsoft account again after logout and confirm the same userId is returned.
